comment: On the second day of class, he dropped a Kingdom Hearts reference. That is like totally all you need to know. He is my favorite. I love this professor. He is so good. He likes teaching. I like learning. This has been a great experience. I am happy. You are happy. We are happy. He is happy. Happy. I like Kingdom Hearts. Kingdom Hearts 2.

Great having Dr. Sparacino for summer PLSC 220. Fair class, consisted of readings - textbook is accessible & easy to read - 2 tests, and 2 papers, plus participation. Weekly Zoom meeting. Perfect guy to take this class with - he gave great feedback and always willing to meet. Very responsive to emails. Looking forward to another class with him.

If you put in the effort this class is an easy A. There are two 5 page papers, one debate, a midterm, and an online final. There is a lot of information covered on the exams, but most questions are easy. You don't need to read the textbook/buy it. All you need to know is in the slides and primary source readings. Sparacino is great

Lecture heavy with some participation. Grades tough on papers but debate, midterm, and final are times to make up for that. Funny guy who cares about his students. Definitely recommend american gov with him!

Dr. Sparacino is very smart and knows what he's talking about. Each class is a lecture the whole time. Two 5- page papers, one debate, a midterm, and an online final. Tests are manageable as long as you study the material. He gives great feedback on papers and is available to help students outside of class. Class gave me a lot of knowledge.

Enjoyed this class a lot. Was lecture heavy and had a fair bit of reading but not daunting at all. He was super nice and helpful when needed. Makes jokes in class so the class isn't totally a drag even though its a lot of lecturing. Would take a class with him again. You can tell he knows his stuff

Professor Sparacino is passionate about what he teaches. He makes a lot of self-deprecating dad jokes. The class is very lecture-based. Each student has to participate in at least one debate. There are very few graded assignments for the course: 2 papers, a debate, the midterm, and the final. He provides extra credit for doing an extra debate.

Sparacino is great. Class structure is reliable: lecture with some back and forth debate and conversation. Graded on midterm, final, a couple of papers which are easy enough if you do the readings, a debate, and participation. Great guy, amusing with no obvious political bias and passionate. Gotta take this course with him if you have to/want to.

Hes an absolute goat, if youre interested in taking PLSC courses I highly recommend him. Grade is compromised of a debate, two papers, a midterm, a final, and general participation. Very fair and hasnt revealed any sort of political bias at all. Fair grader and gives extra credit for doing an extra debate. Lectures are interesting. Awesome guy.

Sparacino is just a solid professor. I wouldn't say his class left me inspired, but he's passionate about what he teaches. There is a lecture every class and everyone is required to do a debate, but if you do two you get extra credit. There is only the midterm and the final, which are both tough. He's focused on the concepts, not the vocab words.
absolute beast, for sure take if you enjoy american politics

Dr. Sparacino is a nice enough guy, but he doesn't portray much passion for American Government. He does occassional make a slightly amusing dad joke and he cares about your success, but success in his class comes mainly down to the memorization of facts in order to pass his mid-term and final. He gave a lot of hints before exams.
